_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Wires the rule engine into the bookkeeping lifecycle. Adds `OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\RuleComplianceGuard::validateInvoice` to ARInvoice.issue (a transition with no prior `requires` — a clean addition) and overrides GLTransaction.post.requires from BalanceGuard::isBalanced to `RuleComplianceGuard::validateTransaction`. Both run OCA\Shillinq\Standards\RuleEngine over the object and block the transition when a MANDATORY machine-checkable rule from the RuleCatalogue is violated: invoice = EN 16931 BR-02/03/05/13/14 + BR-CO-15 (total-with-VAT = net + VAT) + sequential numbering; GL = completeness (>=2 lines, each account+amount+side) + sequential journal numbering, with the double-entry balance invariant preserved exactly by delegating to the existing BalanceGuard inside validateTransaction. The GLTransaction.post override is safe under SettingsService::deepMergeConfig: it recurses into transitions.post and replaces only the `requires` scalar, preserving the existing allocation-rule `actions`. No new schema; this fragment only attaches guards to existing transitions.
